note: Labelled question+table→parse set for breadth step 4's table-scoped parser (Task 4). Every table is one of Task 1's eligible fixture tables under tests/fixtures/tableparse/schemas/<tableId>.json (schema+codeLists capture, metadata-only, R1). 'expect.measureCode' is a measure code copied verbatim from the table's own measure list, or 'geen' when no measure in the table answers the question. 'expect.breakdowns' has exactly one entry per offered breakdown dimension (classifyDimension === 'breakdown' — time/geo/geo_like/margins never appear here), each a member code copied verbatim from that dimension's fixture code list, 'niet_genoemd' (the question says nothing about that dimension — step 3's resolver then either falls to CBS's own grand total or asks, depending on whether one exists), or 'anders' (the question names a real member the deterministic pre-filter cut from the offered list). 'expect.periodKind' is the periodSpecSchema discriminant only. 'expect.regions' is the plain list of place names the question names verbatim (only meaningful on a table with hasRegions=true; empty otherwise). Every code was checked against the real fixture (measure lists, dimension code lists) and, for truncated dimensions (>MEMBER_PROMPT_CAP members), against buildTableParseSchema's ACTUAL offered list for that exact question text — not guessed. Grand-total resolvability per dimension (used to write honest 'falls to total' vs 'no total' cases) was checked with src/query/breakdowns.ts's own findGrandTotal, not assumed from the title alone. Category minimums (brief): geen ≥4, niet_genoemd-falls-to-total ≥4 (id prefix 'total-'; several more appear incidentally in other cases), anders ≥3, two-totals/no-total dimension ≥3 (id prefix 'nototal-'; a couple more appear incidentally), region ≥2 (a couple more appear incidentally via explicit 'Nederland' mentions), period-grain-unavailable ≥2 (id prefix 'grain-') — every one of these minimums, and the exact per-category counts, is enforced by tests/answer/table-parse/labelled-set.test.ts, not restated here as a number that could drift out of sync with the case list below. The remaining cases (id prefix 'general-') are happy-path breadth across the remaining tables/dimensions/period kinds. Controller-ruling correction: the brief guessed 'probably 03759ned' as the one fixture table with regions — buildTableParseSchema (run against every eligible fixture) shows BOTH 03759ned and 84521NED have hasRegions=true (both have a GeoDimension-kind RegioS). The 2 designated region cases use 03759ned; 84521NED's regions are exercised incidentally never in this set (left for a later step).
